methods.name: tabBar.set
methods.description: Register a bounded declarative tab-bar control owned by this runtime. Defaults to own plugin views and trailing placement; when:{} targets all tabs. Groups are plugin-scoped. showLabel keeps button text alongside its icon; checked is button-only, host-rendered, and acknowledged through set. Narrow panes move controls into an accessible overflow menu. Commands must belong to this plugin. Eight items per plugin, 128 total; removed on stop or revocation. Click context is advisory, never authorization.

methods.name: tabBar.remove
methods.description: Remove this runtime's tab-bar control; return false if absent.

methods.name: statusBar.set
methods.description: Register or replace this runtime's status item. Eight per plugin, 128 total; plain text only. Click commands must be this plugin's non-editor, non-file-menu manifest commands. Items disappear on stop, revocation, crash or restart.

methods.name: statusBar.remove
methods.description: Remove this runtime's status item; return false when absent. IDs are scoped to the plugin and runtime generation.

methods.name: editor.active
methods.description: Read the active ready editor document or null. Returns tabId, documentId, version, path, name, content and dirty. Maximum UTF-8 content 128KiB. Does not read files from disk.

methods.name: editor.replace
methods.description: Replace an open editor buffer only if the document identity and version still match. Maximum UTF-8 text 128KiB. Undoable; never saves automatically. Rejects stale, closed, loading or disconnected documents.

methods.name: mounts.browse
methods.description: Browse directories through an authenticated SFTP session for the mount chooser.

methods.name: mounts.open
methods.description: Open this plugin's mount in the system file manager.

methods.name: mounts.documentation
methods.description: Open platform SSHFS installation instructions in the system browser.

methods.name: mounts.dependencies
methods.description: Detect SSHFS and FUSE compatibility; never install software or drivers.

methods.name: mounts.list
methods.description: List this plugin's own SSHFS mounts.

methods.name: mounts.mount
methods.description: Mount using an authenticated SSH subsystem and the host's proxy/jump route. Defaults read-only.

methods.name: mounts.unmount
methods.description: Unmount this plugin's own SSHFS filesystem; never terminate unrelated processes.

methods.name: forwards.list
methods.description: Read saved TCP forwarding rules and running status.

methods.name: forwards.save
methods.description: Create or update a validated TCP forwarding rule; active rules must be stopped first.

methods.name: forwards.remove
methods.description: Remove a saved forwarding rule and stop its active connections.

methods.name: forwards.start
methods.description: Start a saved forward through its host's active authenticated session; stopped on plugin revocation.

methods.name: forwards.stop
methods.description: Stop a forwarding listener and its active connections.

methods.name: runners.deploy
methods.description: After explicit confirmation, deploy an optional selected native helper and this plugin into a fresh user directory. Never install Node or modify services.

methods.name: runners.start
methods.description: Start a durable plugin runner using a previously approved deployment; secrets travel over SSH stdin, not files or argv.

methods.name: runners.list
methods.description: Read this plugin's durable runner records, including stopPending for unreachable revoked tasks.

methods.name: runners.send
methods.description: Enqueue an RPC request or approval response for this plugin's own remote runner.

methods.name: runners.poll
methods.description: Read sequenced durable runner events and pending approvals after reconnect.

methods.name: runners.status
methods.description: Read this plugin's remote runner status.

methods.name: runners.stop
methods.description: Persist and request stopping a remote runner; does not claim that an unreachable process has stopped.

methods.name: events.publish
methods.description: Publish a bounded plugin-identified UI event; the host supplies identity and runtime generation.

methods.name: secrets.get
methods.description: Read this plugin's own OS-keyring secret; return string or null. Never exposes SSH credentials.

methods.name: secrets.set
methods.description: Store this plugin's own secret in the operating system keyring, at most 16KiB.

methods.name: secrets.delete
methods.description: Delete this plugin's own keyring secret.

methods.name: tasks.start
methods.description: Start an explicitly selected executable; requires process.exec locally or ssh.exec remotely. Return taskId. Separate bounded stdout/stderr; default 30 minutes, maximum 24 hours.

methods.name: tasks.list
methods.description: List this runtime's own background processes.

methods.name: tasks.status
methods.description: Read this runtime's own process status and exit code.

methods.name: tasks.readOutput
methods.description: Read bounded sequenced stdout/stderr events; truncated reports expired output.

methods.name: tasks.write
methods.description: Write UTF-8 to this runtime's own process stdin; at most 128KiB.

methods.name: tasks.closeInput
methods.description: Close this runtime's own process stdin.

methods.name: tasks.cancel
methods.description: Stop this runtime's own process; local process trees are terminated, remote server signal support may vary.

methods.name: tools.invoke
methods.description: Execute an allowlisted AI/MCP tool after permission, target scope and approval checks. ReadOnly rejects every command and mutation. Review may only be supplied by a trusted plugin's independent reviewer.

methods.name: tools.cancel
methods.description: Cancel this plugin runtime's pending tool invocation; already completed operations cannot be rolled back.

methods.name: tools.revokeClient
methods.description: Cancel pending tool invocations owned by this plugin runtime's client.

methods.name: api.describe
methods.description: List the fixed versioned host API; every request still checks runtime authorization.

resultSchema.title: Plugin API discovery v1 response
resultSchema.description: Compatibility floor for api.describe. Consumers must ignore unknown fields and stability values.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Write a bounded plugin-tagged log message.

methods.name: app.info
methods.description: Read application metadata, platform and preference schema; no credentials.

methods.name: app.openExternal
methods.description: Open an http/https URL with the system browser.

methods.name: settings.get
methods.description: Read application preferences.

methods.name: settings.update
methods.description: Update and sanitize preferences through the normal settings service.

methods.name: hosts.snapshot
methods.description: Read saved host and group metadata; authentication secrets are never returned.

methods.name: hosts.create
methods.description: Create a validated saved host.

methods.name: hosts.update
methods.description: Replace a saved host's validated metadata.

methods.name: hosts.delete
methods.description: Delete a saved host and forget its stored credential.

methods.name: hosts.markUsed
methods.description: Update a saved host's last-used time.

methods.name: hosts.reorder
methods.description: Persist the order of saved hosts; at most 500 IDs.

methods.name: groups.create
methods.description: Create a validated host group.

methods.name: groups.update
methods.description: Update a validated host group.

methods.name: groups.delete
methods.description: Delete a host group through the normal group service.

methods.name: sessions.list
methods.description: List active SSH session metadata; no passwords or private keys.

methods.name: sessions.connect
methods.description: Connect a saved host with normal host-key verification; never auto-trust a server.

methods.name: sessions.disconnect
methods.description: Disconnect an active SSH session.

methods.name: sessions.exec
methods.description: Execute in a separate SSH channel; return stdout/stderr/exitCode/signal. Timeout 100–60000ms, output at most 1MiB.

methods.name: terminal.write
methods.description: Write plain UTF-8 terminal input, including remote shell commands; the host handles transport encoding.

methods.name: terminal.resize
methods.description: Resize the remote terminal through the validated session service.

methods.name: files.local.home
methods.description: Read the local home directory path.

methods.name: files.local.list
methods.description: List a local directory.

methods.name: files.local.readText
methods.description: Read a UTF-8 local text file, at most 512KiB; reject binary data.

methods.name: files.local.writeText
methods.description: Atomically replace existing local UTF-8 text, at most 512KiB; optional baseline detects external edits.

methods.name: files.local.createFile
methods.description: Create an empty local file without replacing an existing file.

methods.name: files.local.mkdir
methods.description: Create a local directory.

methods.name: files.local.rename
methods.description: Rename a local file or directory; overwriting is opt-in.

methods.name: files.local.copy
methods.description: Copy local files/directories through the existing copy service.

methods.name: files.local.delete
methods.description: Delete a local file or directory.

methods.name: files.sftp.list
methods.description: List a remote directory using an active SSH session.

methods.name: files.sftp.resolveDirectory
methods.description: Resolve the SSH account home and an optional working directory through SFTP without listing entries or executing a shell. Return {home,path}. Supports ~ and relative paths.

methods.name: files.sftp.readText
methods.description: Read remote UTF-8 text through the editor service; API response size limits apply.

methods.name: files.sftp.writeText
methods.description: Atomically replace existing remote text; optional baseline detects external edits.

methods.name: files.sftp.createFile
methods.description: Create an empty remote file without replacing an existing file.

methods.name: files.sftp.mkdir
methods.description: Create a remote directory.

methods.name: files.sftp.rename
methods.description: Rename a remote file/directory; overwriting is opt-in.

methods.name: files.sftp.copy
methods.description: Copy remote files/directories within a session.

methods.name: files.sftp.delete
methods.description: Delete a remote file or directory.

methods.name: files.upload
methods.description: Copy a local file or directory to a remote path. Return transferId; cancellation, progress and file refresh use the normal transfer service. Revoking access or stopping this runtime cancels its active transfers.

methods.name: files.download
methods.description: Copy a remote file or directory to a local path. Return transferId; never remove the source. Revoking access or stopping this runtime cancels its active transfers.

methods.name: files.cancelTransfer
methods.description: Cancel only a transfer owned by this plugin's current runtime. Return true if its active transfer was found; false for completed, missing or other owners' transfers.

methods.name: files.transferStatus
methods.description: Read progress or the final TransferEvent for this runtime's own transfer; return null for missing, other-owner or expired IDs. The latest 256 completed plugin transfers are retained in memory.

methods.name: monitor.system
methods.description: Read local CPU, memory, disk and network statistics.

methods.name: monitor.stats
methods.description: Sample remote system statistics.

methods.name: monitor.processes
methods.description: List remote processes.

methods.name: monitor.kill
methods.description: Send TERM to a remote process; protected process validation still applies.

methods.name: history.list
methods.description: Read saved command history, at most 500 rows.

methods.name: history.record
methods.description: Record a command for an existing saved host.

methods.name: history.delete
methods.description: Delete one command-history entry.

methods.name: history.clear
methods.description: Clear a saved host's command history.

methods.name: workspace.snapshot
methods.description: Read a detached v1 snapshot of live tabs, panes, active IDs and split layout, including hidden panels and file-pane metadata. No file contents, credentials or arbitrary store fields. Tab kinds and file-view option values are open vocabularies; tolerate unfamiliar values. The snapshot neither reserves resources nor grants their permissions.

resultSchema.title: Detached plugin workspace snapshot v1
resultSchema.description: Live presentation metadata; no file contents, credentials or resource reservation. Ignore unknown fields and string option values.

methods.name: workspace.openPage
methods.description: Open or focus an existing application page.

methods.name: workspace.openHost
methods.description: Open a saved host's details; never reveal an authentication secret.

methods.name: workspace.openTerminal
methods.description: Open a terminal tab for an already-connected session.

methods.name: workspace.openFiles
methods.description: Open a file browser for an already-connected session.

methods.name: workspace.openSidebar
methods.description: Dock a list into the current workspace group.

methods.name: workspace.activate
methods.description: Activate an existing tab and its group.

methods.name: workspace.close
methods.description: Close a tab; dirty editors retain the normal user confirmation. Result reports pending confirmation.

methods.name: workspace.split
methods.description: Move a tab into a split group.

methods.name: workspace.move
methods.description: Move or reorder an existing tab.

methods.name: workspace.showQuickAccess
methods.description: Open Quick Access with an optional query. Never execute a command automatically.

methods.name: workspace.setPaneLocked
methods.description: Set the destination lock on an existing pane.

methods.name: workspace.resizeSplit
methods.description: Resize an existing split with a ratio between 0.1 and 0.9.

methods.name: workspace.returnSidebar
methods.description: Return a docked list to the sidebar.

methods.name: clipboard.readText
methods.description: Read the system text clipboard.

methods.name: clipboard.writeText
methods.description: Replace the system text clipboard.

methods.name: storage.get
methods.description: Read plugin-scoped JSON data. Keys use 1–128 ASCII letters, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore.

methods.name: storage.set
methods.description: Persist plugin-scoped JSON data, at most 256KiB total per plugin.

methods.name: storage.delete
methods.description: Remove a key from plugin-scoped JSON data.

methods.name: ui.showMessage
methods.description: Show a bounded notification prefixed with the installed plugin's identity.

methods.name: ui.confirm
methods.description: Ask the user a plugin-identified confirmation; never replace an existing dialog.
